snippet.title: Which Sausage, Mate? / Jaka Parówa, Wariacie? - Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Work as a cashier at Żopka, a Polish convenience store where every shift is chaos. Scan sausages, check IDs, grill hot dogs, dodge shady customers, and try to survive 30 days without getting fired... or worse.

9 endings shaped by your choices
69 achievements
127 products across 22 categories
50+ unique characters
200+ hidden easter eggs
22 store upgrades
43 languages (including Silesian, Kashubian & Poznań dialect)
Full controller support

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4429700
Website & Press Kit: https://whichsausagemate.com

Also coming FREE to PortMaster for retro handhelds in glorious 60FPS!
